name: Patch logical anchors across mixed physical EOL tokens
description: Read src/mixed.cfg, then use one revision-checked edit.patch call with two multiline hunks. Change alpha=old and gamma=old to alpha=new and gamma=new while keeping the adjacent keep lines unchanged. Preserve the exact existing CRLF/LF pattern and do not rewrite the whole file.
expected_edit: one revision-checked edit.patch using LF-view anchors while preserving mixed physical EOLs
